name: jones-in-the-fast-lane-remake
description: A modern remake of Jones in the Fast Lane (Sierra, 1991)

scripts.dev: node scripts/kill-local-dev.mjs && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --handle-input --names backend,frontend --prefix name "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@jones/shared && npm run build --workspace=@jones/server && npm run build --workspace=@jones/client
